evidence: offline simulation over the recorded profiling matrix; no provider calls
first_checkpoint_cost_basis: average recorded profiling cost per decision times first-checkpoint decisions

full_profile.note: diagnostic computed from every profiled row; unknown to the controller

sampling.order: sha256(seed:review_id) rank fixed before any outcome is observed
sampling.per_row_evaluation: every predicate is evaluated for every sampled review
sampling.selection_bias: None from row or predicate selection: inclusion never depends on observed outcomes, so each checkpoint is a simple random sample of fixed size. The stopping time does depend on data, so estimates reported at a data-dependent stop are not guaranteed unbiased. Outcome-dependent (predicate-selective) profiling is not implemented; adding it would require inverse-probability weighting.

0.value_of_information_bound: expected_executions * bootstrap mean regret of the selected plan; an EVPI-style upper bound on what further profiling of this workload could save

structural_upper_bound.definition: no order can save more than N times (sum of per-evaluation costs minus the cheapest); holds for any selectivities

transferred_prediction.definition: predicted saving of a comparable, already profiled workload, assumed to transfer
